label.en: App Store: FamilyMart online shop app

title.zh-TW: 首次購買滿 NT$300，現折 NT$50
title.en: NT$50 off a first purchase of NT$300 or more

text.zh-TW: 結帳時輸入優惠碼 MGMCKQ0RC，訂單現折 NT$50；限首次購買。取自平台分享文案與邀請頁；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: Enter promo code MGMCKQ0RC at checkout for NT$50 off; first purchase only. From the share text and invite page; official terms prevail.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟推薦連結（會前往全家行動購的邀請頁）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the referral link (it leads to the FamilyMart online shop invitation page).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示登入或註冊全家行動購會員。
steps.en: Log in or register as a member of the shop as the page asks.

steps.zh-TW: 選購商品，讓首次購買的訂單金額達 NT$300 以上。
steps.en: Shop so that your first purchase order reaches NT$300 or more.

steps.zh-TW: 結帳時輸入優惠碼 MGMCKQ0RC（已包含在連結中；若結帳頁沒有自動帶入，請手動輸入），訂單即現折 NT$50。
steps.en: At checkout, enter promo code MGMCKQ0RC (already in the link; if it is not filled in, type it in) for NT$50 off the order.

intro.zh-TW: 全家行動購首次購買訂單滿 NT$300，結帳輸入優惠碼 MGMCKQ0RC，訂單現折 NT$50。
intro.en: FamilyMart’s online shop: on a first order of NT$300 or more, enter promo code MGMCKQ0RC at checkout for NT$50 off.

description.zh-TW:
全家行動購是全家便利商店的線上購物商店與 App。本頁連結已包含優惠碼 MGMCKQ0RC；依邀請頁，限首次購買，訂單消費達 NT$300（含）以上，訂單現折 NT$50。手動輸入時請依原樣（含大小寫）。

依邀請頁顯示，活動期間為 2026-10-01 至 2026-10-31；首張訂單若有取消或退貨，之後再下單沒有這項優惠。
description.en:
全家行動購 is the online shop and app of the FamilyMart convenience store chain in Taiwan. The promo code MGMCKQ0RC is already part of the referral link on this page. According to the invitation page, an invited friend can use the promo code only on a first purchase, and an order of NT$300 or more gets NT$50 off. If the code is needed at checkout, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization.

The invitation page shows a campaign period of 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31, and if the first order is cancelled or returned, later orders no longer get the offer.

notes.zh-TW: 手動輸入優惠碼時，Q 與 R 之間是數字 0，不是字母 O。本站沒有測試結帳時優惠碼是否被接受。
notes.en: If you type the code in, the character between Q and R is the digit zero, not the letter O. This site did not test whether the code is accepted at checkout.

q.zh-TW: MGMCKQ0RC 這組優惠碼在全家行動購怎麼使用？
q.en: How do I use promo code MGMCKQ0RC at the FamilyMart online shop?

a.zh-TW: 依邀請頁，限首次購買，訂單消費達 NT$300（含）以上，結帳時使用優惠碼 MGMCKQ0RC，訂單現折 NT$50。本頁連結已包含這組優惠碼，結帳頁若沒有自動帶入，請依原樣（含大小寫）手動輸入。
a.en: According to the invitation page, on a first purchase only, an order of NT$300 or more gets NT$50 off when you use promo code MGMCKQ0RC at checkout. The code is already part of the link on this page; if it is not filled in at checkout, type it in exactly as shown, including capitalization.

q.zh-TW: 這個折扣是給誰的？有活動期限嗎？
q.en: Who gets the discount, and is there a deadline?

a.zh-TW: 折扣給被邀請的好友，也就是使用這組優惠碼的人，限在官網或 App 完成第一筆訂單；首單若有取消或退貨，之後再下單沒有這項優惠。邀請頁顯示的活動期間是 2026-10-01 至 2026-10-31，實際條件以官方公告為準。
a.en: The discount is for the invited friend who uses the promo code, and only on the first order placed on the website or in the app; if that first order is cancelled or returned, later orders get no offer. The invitation page shows a campaign period of 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-31, and actual terms follow the official announcements.
